name: pwa-push-notifications
description: Build a Progressive Web App (PWA) on Next.js with Web Push (VAPID) notifications so users can install the app to their home screen and receive native push notifications when events fire — engine signals, messages, alerts. Covers manifest.json authoring, service worker (app-shell caching, push handler, notificationclick), VAPID key generation and storage, push_subscriptions table schema, server-side fan-out via the web-push npm package, and the iOS Safari quirks that bite every PWA (no beforeinstallprompt event, push only works from home-screen-launched standalone, Safari-only install path). Use when the user says "make this a PWA", "let users install the app", "add push notifications to the phone", "send native browser push", "Web Push VAPID", or wants mobile-app-like behavior without going through the App Store.
